en.description:
Animal Cube Dash is an adorable, action-packed side-scrolling platformer for Apple Watch and iPhone — designed for players of all ages!

  Guide your animal cube through fast-paced obstacle courses, dodge traps, and reach the finish line. Simple to pick up, impossible to put down!

  COLLECT 20+ ANIMAL SKINS
  Unlock skins across five rarity tiers — Common, Rare, Ultra Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Show off your rarest finds and flex on your friends!

   EARN LEGENDARY STATUS
  Complete 5 perfect levels in a row without a single death to unlock the most exclusive Legendary skins. Only the best of the best earn these!

   COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
  Climb the Game Center leaderboard and challenge your friends. Who can reach the highest level?

   BRAG ABOUT YOUR WINS
  One-tap share cards let you show off perfect runs, speed clears, and rare skin unlocks — with a link so your friends can download and compete!

   APPLE WATCH + iPHONE
  Play on your wrist or on your phone — your progress syncs automatically between devices.

   SIMPLE CONTROLS
  Tap to jump, swipe to dodge. Pick up and play in seconds!

  Made with love  by Ahaana Sistla
en.releaseNotes: Animal town feature include. Feed your cute animal, make him sleep when tired and brush its teeth
en.subtitle: Animal cube adventure game

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
iPhone app is here!  Play the full Animal Cube Dash experience on your iPhone — same addictive gameplay, now on a bigger screen!  
                                                                                                                                      
  New in 2.0:                                               
  - Full iPhone game — dash, dodge, and jump on your phone                                                                         
  - Watch an ad to earn an extra life when you're this close to beating a level
  - Get notified right in the app when a new update is available                                                                   
  - Share your wins with friends — brag cards now include a direct download link so your friends can join the fun                  
  - Tons of new funny and proud brag messages                                                                                      
  - Bug fixes and performance improvements
